Coram : PAMIDIGHANTAM SRI NARASIMHA*, SANDEEP MEHTA
Issue for Consideration Whether specific and clear acknowledgement of debt by the Corporate Debtor in its balance sheet is necessary while considering limitation under Section 18 of the Limitation Act, 1963. Headnotes† Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 – s.238A – s.18 of acknowledge of debt in the balance sheet entries necessary while computing limitation u/s.18 Limitation Act r/w s.238A of the IBC: Held: It was contended by the Appellant that there is no unequivocal, unambiguous and specific acknowledgement of debt owed to Respondent – Financial Creditor
Decision Date : 22-10-2024 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1031/2022 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
